description: This file defines a class TenantProfilesTableConfigResolver that configures and manages the tenant profiles table in the UI, including actions like export, set default, import, delete, and navigation to tenant profile details.

classes.name: TenantProfilesTableConfigResolver
classes.description: Angular service that provides configuration for the tenant profiles table, including columns, actions, and data fetching functions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for tenant profiles, setting the table title.

methods.name: configureAddActions
methods.description: Creates and returns the list of add action buttons for creating and importing tenant profiles.

methods.name: openTenantProfile
methods.description: Navigates to the tenant profile detail page.

methods.name: setDefaultTenantProfile
methods.description: Sets a tenant profile as default after user confirmation.

methods.name: importTenantProfile
methods.description: Triggers import of a tenant profile and refreshes the table data.

methods.name: onTenantProfileAction
methods.description: Handles actions like 'open' and 'setDefault' triggered from the table.
